Agent Name: Financial_Expert
, Step Number: 10
, Reason for Mistake: In calculating the revenue-to-rent ratio, they only dropped rows with missing Name, leaving non-vendor header rows like “Zone 2” (which have NaN Revenue/Rent) and any rows with missing or zero Rent/Revenue in the dataset. They then computed the ratio and took idxmin without rigorously filtering to valid vendor rows (e.g., requiring non-null, positive numeric Revenue and Rent, and a valid Type). This insufficient data cleaning can lead to an incorrect minimum ratio selection and thus the wrong vendor/type.
